name: shape-timestamped-signature
description: Format demonstration: the signed payload includes a timestamp and the header carries more than the bare digest. Stripe's scheme has this form (t=<ts>,v1=<hmac> over "<ts>.<body>").
notes: A format demonstration, not a verified Stripe fixture. TODO(human): if you are integrating Stripe, confirm the scheme and tolerance window against their current webhook docs before copying this. Run with --timestamp=<unix seconds> to make the digest reproducible.
